evals.name: Read DICOM volume with medicalVolume
evals.description: Tests that the agent uses medicalVolume (not raw dicomreadVolume) when Medical Imaging Toolbox is available
evals.prompt: I have a folder of DICOM CT files at 'ctData/'. Read the volume data, get the voxel spacing in mm, check the orientation, and extract the 50th transverse slice. Use the best available MATLAB APIs.

context.setup: Ensure Medical Imaging Toolbox and Image Processing Toolbox are available

assertions.description: Uses medicalVolume to read the DICOM folder
Accesses VoxelSpacing property for spacing
Uses extractSlice for oriented slice extraction
Does not fall back to raw dicomreadVolume when MIT is available
extractSlice argument order is correct: (vol, sliceIndex, direction) with numeric before string
assertions.expected: extractSlice is called with arguments in order: volume object, numeric slice index, direction string

evals.name: Spatial coordinate conversion with medicalref3d
evals.description: Tests that the agent correctly uses intrinsicToWorld with 3 separate outputs and worldToSubscript for indexing
evals.prompt: I have a medical volume loaded as 'vol = medicalVolume("brain.nii.gz")'. Write MATLAB code to: (1) Get the world coordinates of voxel position [128, 128, 64], (2) Convert world coordinates [-50.0, -80.0, -200.0] back to the nearest voxel subscripts for indexing, (3) Check if that world point is inside the volume bounds. Use the spatial referencing API from Medical Imaging Toolbox.

context.setup: Ensure Medical Imaging Toolbox is available

assertions.description: Uses intrinsicToWorld for voxel-to-world conversion
intrinsicToWorld returns 3 separate outputs [x, y, z], not captured as single vector
assertions.expected: intrinsicToWorld is called with 3 separate scalar arguments and captured into 3 separate output variables like [wx, wy, wz] or [x, y, z]

assertions.description: Uses worldToSubscript for nearest-voxel indexing
Uses VolumeGeometry to access the spatial referencing object
Uses contains method for bounds checking

evals.name: DICOM RT structure modify and write
evals.description: Tests the full dicomContours lifecycle: read, inspect, delete, convert, and write with CreateMode=Copy
evals.prompt: I have a DICOM RT Structure file at 'rtstruct.dcm'. Write MATLAB code to: (1) Read it and display the ROI names, (2) Delete ROIs numbered 1 and 3, (3) Write the modified structure to 'modified_rtstruct.dcm'. Make sure the output file is valid DICOM.

context.setup: Ensure Image Processing Toolbox is available

assertions.description: Uses dicomContours to parse the RT structure
dicomContours is passed a dicominfo struct, not a file path
assertions.expected: dicomContours is called with the output of dicominfo (a struct variable), not directly with a filename string

assertions.description: deleteContour output is captured (immutable pattern) and both ROIs deleted in one call
assertions.expected: deleteContour result is assigned back to a variable (e.g., contours = deleteContour(contours, ...)), and ROIs 1 and 3 are passed together as a vector [1 3] in a single call rather than sequential calls

assertions.description: Uses convertToInfo to reconstruct DICOM metadata
convertToInfo takes only the contours object (no second argument)
assertions.expected: convertToInfo is called with a single argument (the dicomContours object) — no second argument like the original info struct

assertions.description: Uses CreateMode=Copy for RT DICOM write

evals.name: Batch DICOM anonymization with shared UIDs
evals.description: Tests that the agent uses dicomanon with shared UIDs for series consistency
evals.prompt: I have a folder of DICOM files at 'patientData/' that form a single CT series. Write MATLAB code to anonymize all files into 'anonData/', replacing patient name with 'ANON_SUBJECT' and patient ID with 'S001'. Make sure all anonymized files remain grouped as one series in a DICOM viewer.

context.setup: Ensure Image Processing Toolbox is available

assertions.description: Uses dicomanon for anonymization
Uses dicomuid to generate shared UIDs
Generates StudyInstanceUID and SeriesInstanceUID ONCE before the loop and applies to all files via update
assertions.expected: dicomuid is called to generate StudyInstanceUID and SeriesInstanceUID before the loop (not inside it), and these shared UIDs are passed to dicomanon via the update name-value argument for every file

assertions.description: Does not generate unique UIDs per file inside the loop
assertions.expected: dicomuid is NOT called inside the for/while loop body

evals.name: Read NIfTI and change orientation
evals.description: Tests that the agent uses updateOrientation (not permute) to reorient a volume
evals.prompt: I have a transverse NIfTI brain volume at 'brain.nii.gz'. Read it using Medical Imaging Toolbox, check its orientation, then reorient it to coronal view. Save the reoriented volume to 'brain_coronal.nii.gz'.

context.setup: Ensure Medical Imaging Toolbox is available

assertions.description: Uses medicalVolume to read the NIfTI file
Uses updateOrientation for reorientation
Does not use permute for orientation change
updateOrientation result is captured in a new variable (returns new object)
assertions.expected: updateOrientation result is assigned to a variable (e.g., volCoronal = updateOrientation(vol, "coronal")) rather than called without capturing the output

assertions.description: Uses write method to save the reoriented volume
